overview_description.description:
Cypress.io develops an automated end-to-end and component testing solution for anything that runs in a browser. The company offers the open-source Cypress App, a test engine that combines existing testing tools with a graphical user interface to monitor and debug tests.

Additionally, Cypress Cloud is a hosted service that aggregates and applies powerful intelligence from past Cypress App test runs to support better CI failure debugging workflows, test suite analytics, and intelligent CI orchestration capabilities that improve developer velocity while reducing CI costs.

Cypress has more than 3,700 customers across 78 countries and  65 industries who have recorded over 5 billion tests. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.

product.name: Cypress Testing Framework
product.description: A JavaScript testing framework for writing, running, and debugging tests for modern web applications directly in the browser.

product.name: Cypress Cloud
product.description: A cloud service that enhances test execution with features like parallelization, load balancing, test replay, and analytics for CI pipelines.

product.name: UI Coverage
product.description: A tool to track, monitor, and visualize UI test coverage to identify testing gaps and prevent regressions in web applications.

product.name: Automated Accessibility Checks
product.description: A feature that automatically detects, visualizes, and helps fix accessibility violations during test runs without extra coding.
